title: feat(runtime): a host can supply the package-state store (createPackageStateStorePlugin); a refused write fails the enable/disable door with nothing changed
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoNFPj8KV1KqL2puViUBBKLC)_

Fixes #30962

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：模块启用/停用状态的存放处可由宿主提供。宿主在内核里加 `createPackageStateStorePlugin(store)`，启动种子和启用/停用/安装/删除各门都改读写这个存储；不加则仍是 `OS_HOME` 下的那个文件，字节不变。
- 为什么改：托管云上容器一换，`OS_HOME` 里的文件就没了，管理员在设置里关掉的模块会重新出现（cloud#3636，裁决「AAAA + 三条验收（推荐）」）。平台补上缺的宿主接缝，cloud 只需实现托管存储。
- 风险与回滚：启用/停用门改成先写存储、再改内存；宿主存储拒写时门答 503 且什么都不变。未注入时行为与文件内容不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` 的启用、停用两门（先写存储的顺序与 503 分支）；`packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts` 的 `seedPersistedDisabledPackages` 与 `refuseLatePackageStateStore`；新文件 `packages/runtime/src/package-state-host-store.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/package-state-host-store.test.ts`，预期 11 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**The seam (`packages/runtime/src/package-state-host-store.ts`, exported from `@objectstack/runtime`).** `PackageStateStore` is `loadDisabledPackageIds(environmentId)` plus `setPackageDisabled(environmentId, packageId, disabled)`, either may return a promise. A host adds `createPackageStateStorePlugin(store)` to its kernel; that plugin (`com.objectstack.package-state-store`) registers the store as the `package-state-store` kernel service. This is the door a host already uses to hand the runtime anything: `createStandaloneStack` returns a `plugins` list the host composes into its kernel, so no new top-level option was added. `AppPlugin` lists the plugin name in `optionalDependencies` (ADR-0116), so the store is registered before the boot seed reads it whatever slot the host puts it in; `check:init-service-contract` now holds that init-time read to the declaration.

**Boot seed (`AppPlugin.seedPersistedDisabledPackages`).** Reads the host store when one is registered, else the file exactly as before (best-effort, warns). A host store whose read throws fails the boot with a named error instead of seeding nothing, which would bring every disabled module back enabled with nothing looking wrong (the ADR-0025 §3.5 M1 call the installed-plugin loader already makes). `AppPlugin.start()` refuses a boot that seeded from the file while a store is registered by then (a host registering under the service name from its own, unordered plugin), naming `createPackageStateStorePlugin` as the fix.

**Doors (`domains/packages.ts`).** Every write goes through one `writePackageState`, which looks the store up through the classified lookup (`resolveServiceOrLoud`), so a store factory that throws refuses the write rather than reading as "no host store".
- `PATCH /packages/:id/enable` and `/disable` now write the store FIRST and switch the registry second. A host store that refuses: nothing changes in memory and the door answers `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` (the standard code, no new code), message opening `Package 'ID' was not disabled: the package-state store refused to record it, so nothing changed.` The file default keeps its best-effort `warn` and still switches.
- Install and delete, whose change has already landed when they write, keep their best-effort `try`; a host store's refusal there is logged at `error` naming what the next boot will read, the file's failure keeps the existing `warn`.
- The disable door's dependent-rule scan (#30825, merged) runs first and is untouched; the store write follows it.

## Tests

New `packages/runtime/src/package-state-host-store.test.ts`, a real `ObjectKernel` + `ObjectQLPlugin` + `AppPlugin` and the real `HttpDispatcher` on the package doors, the store plugin composed AFTER `AppPlugin` in `use()` order:

- the boot seeds from the host store and not from the file (the file says the opposite); every enable and disable write reaches the store and the `OS_HOME` state directory is never created; a disable written in one boot is what the next boot (fresh `OS_HOME`) seeds;
- a refusing store: disable answers 503 `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` and the package stays enabled; enable answers 503 and it stays disabled; an unknown id still answers 404 and writes nothing;
- a store whose boot read throws fails the boot; an unordered registration is refused at start; a store missing a method is a `TypeError`;
- without a host store: the file bytes after disable and enable are pinned exactly, and a file that cannot be written still only warns while the disable lands (200).

## Acceptance notes

- **Card acceptance, line by line.** ① A host-injected store sees every enable/disable write (install, enable, disable, delete) and seeds boot: pinned. ② A refusing store makes the enable and disable doors fail visibly (503) with in-memory state unchanged: pinned and ablated (A1, A2). ③ Without injection behaviour is unchanged: file bytes and the warn-only failure pinned and ablated (A3, A4).
- **Cloud C3 (the hosted store, cloud#3636) consumes this**: it implements `PackageStateStore` and adds `createPackageStateStorePlugin(store)` to the hosted kernel.
- **Choices the card did not rule, made here; the seat may overrule.** (a) A host store's boot read that throws fails the boot, not a warn. (b) Install and delete stay best-effort on a host refusal (their change has landed), logged at `error`; only enable and disable, which can write first, answer the refusal. (c) The 503 message embeds the store's own error text; the dispatcher's 5xx leak guard still replaces it if it looks like an internal leak.
- **Not routed through the seam:** `plugin-installation-store.ts` (the local `os plugin disable | enable` commands and the boot-time installed-plugin loader, ADR-0025 §3.5 M1) still reads and writes the file directly. That loop is local-first CLI state; a hosted container that wants it host-backed is a separate card.
- **Overlap:** #30825 merged and is integrated (its dependent scan runs before the store write, unchanged). #30756 (seat thread, branch `fyy60n`) is adding a refusal pre-check to the enable door; whichever PR opens second merges `origin/main` after the first lands.
- No `packages/spec` edit, no new error code. Size: 6 files, +681 / −30.
